art.title: Game Art Collaborations
art.description: A curated collection of artworks produced during collaborations on various game projects, featuring concept art, in-game assets, and character designs.

art.title: Movies & Animations
art.description: An in-depth showcase of artworks from over 10 movies and animations. This collection features aliens, monsters, characters, and detailed VFX shots along with early concept art.

art.title: Sculptures
art.description: A personal collection of six intricate sculptures created using ZBrush, 3ds Max, and Photoshop. Each sculpture represents a fusion of traditional art techniques with modern digital sculpting.

art.title: Digital Doubles
art.description: A comprehensive showcase of over 20 digital doubles created for film productions, highlighting technical and artistic challenges of replicating realistic characters.

art.title: Miscellaneous Art Projects
art.description: A diverse collection of experimental and one-off art projects, encompassing concept art explorations and creative exercises.

art.title: Paintings & Personal Art
art.description: A vibrant collection of personal paintings and mixed media artworks that explore abstract themes and narrative storytelling.

development.title: LandRocker Game
development.description: A multiplayer space mining game that leverages unique seed-based planet generator and voxel technology.

development.title: Battle of Rovers
development.description: A cutting-edge multiplayer AAA game designed to support up to 200 concurrent users with advanced gameplay systems.

development.title: Avatar Maker
development.description: An interactive WebGL avatar maker developed for a major football world championship event with customization features.

development.title: Alef WebGL Game
development.description: An educational quest game developed in WebGL for Alef University, focusing on climate change awareness.

development.title: VR/AR & Interactive Projects
development.description: A diverse collection of VR, AR, Kinect, and interactive installations developed for exhibitions and events.

development.title: Miscellaneous Development Projects
development.description: A collection of various personal and experimental projects spanning web, mobile, and interactive applications.
